point_of_no_return.title: Finish the open ledger before committing
point_of_no_return.why: Passing a commitment removes the unchosen record from the current run.
point_of_no_return.detail: Resolve available requests and preserve the earlier slot before accepting this branch or cycle transition.

levels.1: Keep a separate slot whenever the game asks for a major commitment.
levels.2: Use the first protected decision checkpoint.
levels.3: Reload the save made immediately before the relevant commitment, choose the still-unrecorded branch, and continue until the game permits a clear mark to be saved. Do not overwrite that mark. This guide intentionally withholds the prompt text, involved identities, and narrative result.

levels.1: Rotate available support partners instead of relying on a single favorite.
